messages:
maria: Heads-up — customer ACME (#9247) reports invoice jump after a quick test. They saw the same request counted 3x during a 30s window. Suspect client retries + idempotency TTL. Ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/tickets/9247
kevin: Can you paste the customer's repro steps / SDK version?
maria: Mobile SDK v2.1.0. Repro: network hiccup -> client times out after 5s and fires a retry with a new idempotency header (random GUID). They attached gateway logs showing three requests within 12s.
alex: Billing ledger shows three separate usage rows for the same session_id. billing-bot, any correlating ledger IDs? 
billing-bot: Ledger entries: L-93a1, L-93a2, L-93a3 — all same session_id and same model tokens. Total tokens billed = 1896
elaine: Do we have gateway traces? Any X-Request-Id or trace ids?
maria: Paste of gateway snippet:
```
2026-02-27T14:03:12Z gateway id=gw-4 req=abc123 received X-Idempotency-Key=gid-9a
2026-02-27T14:03:18Z gateway id=gw-4 req=abc123 upstream timeout, responding 504
2026-02-27T14:03:18Z client retry attempt 1 new X-Idempotency-Key=gid-9b
2026-02-27T14:03:20Z gateway forwarded req=abc124 X-Idempotency-Key=gid-9b
2026-02-27T14:03:24Z gateway forwarded req=abc125 X-Idempotency-Key=gid-9c
```
kevin: So client rotates the idempotency key per attempt. Our ledger dedupe uses idempotency key + account id. If client rotates, we can't dedupe. We should dedupe also on request signature (payload hash) + session_id for short window.
alex: Any chance these were from different regions causing eventual consistency issues? Timestamps show same gw-4, so likely single gateway.
maria: Customer says they only retried once, but logs show 2 retries. Maybe SDK retries are exponential and also connection re-open produced duplicate.
elaine: Quick mitigation: update billing job to detect near-duplicate ledger rows by (account_id, model, prompt_hash, minute) and mark duplicates for refund review. I'll open a PR for a soft-dedupe flag.
kevin: Long term fix: change server idempotency logic to accept both explicit X-Idempotency-Key and a fallback request signature computed as sha256(payload|auth_token) and keep dedupe cache TTL=60s. Also update SDK docs to recommend reusing same idempotency key across retries.
alex: Repro steps for eng: run this script simulating two immediate retries with new key:
```
for i in 1 2 3; do
  curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Idempotency-Key: $(uuidgen)" -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  sleep 4
done
```
maria: I've assigned ticket to kevin and created billing escalation #B-312. Customer asked for interim refund if we confirm duplicate billing.
kevin: I'll attach traces and ledger diff to the ticket. ETA for soft refund tool: 24-48h.
maria: Thanks — keeping customer updated. :handshake:
